# Published prayer reference vectors

`prayer-references.json` contains 403 published Adhan JS reference dates across London, Makkah, Singapore, Tehran and Raleigh (2,418 solar-time comparisons). Expected times are fixed numeric test data, not output regenerated by RISE.

Source: [Adhan JS v4.4.6, commit b6e04cd9da28fffc66773404a0a2e9c739370baf](https://github.com/batoulapps/adhan-js/tree/b6e04cd9da28fffc66773404a0a2e9c739370baf). Each case records its exact source URL and, for the four shared files, Git blob ID. The only conversion is 12-hour clock notation to 24-hour notation. Original tolerances are retained: London/Makkah/Raleigh exact, Tehran one minute, Singapore two minutes. The Singapore set includes all 366 dates in 2020.

The shared vectors in upstream `Shared/Times` identify their original reference sources, including Moonsighting, Umm al-Qura, MUIS and PrayTimes. These are historical library conformance cases, not an endorsement or certification of a current mosque timetable. RISE keeps the user-selected method, convention, high-latitude rule and manual alternative.

Upstream licensing is retained in [adhan-LICENSE](adhan-LICENSE). The application dependencies remain pinned; this fixture adds no runtime dependency or network request.
